name: IKEA KNARREVIK Bedside Table / Nightstand - Minimalist Black Metal
description: Selling a highly versatile IKEA KNARREVIK Nightstand / Bedside Table in sleek matte black. This compact steel storage shelf is absolute perfection for small space living, apartments, or tight dorm bedrooms, fitting smoothly right next to a bed or couch setup. Features a durable powder-coated steel construction with a built-in lower secondary shelf to neatly organize books, tech cords, or accessories. The table is fully pre-assembled, saving you from sorting through tedious hex wrenches and metal bars. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly home with a resident cat. The metal surface has been thoroughly vacuumed, wiped down, and sanitized, though minor pet dust particles or faint surface micro-scratches from daily use may exist. Does NOT come with secondary retail storage packaging covers or bags, so local pickup buyers, please bring a trunk blanket or transport container.
contact_note: Fully pre-assembled solid steel structure. Exceptionally lightweight and compact; it can easily fit onto any standard car backseat or trunk floor. Note: From a cat-friendly apartment.
meta_description: Pre-assembled IKEA KNARREVIK Nightstand for sale. Minimalist black powder-coated steel side table, ideal for small spaces. Cleaned and sanitized, good condition.
name_zh: 宜家 IKEA KNARREVIK 科纳列维克 简约金属床头桌 / 双层黑色置物架
description_zh: 低价转让一个超级实用的宜家（IKEA）KNARREVIK（科纳列维克）双层黑色金属床头桌/侧边置物架 [宜家](https://www.ikea.cn/cn/zh/p/knarrevik-ke-na-lie-wei-ke-chuang-tou-zhuo-hei-se-40386731/)。整体采用耐磨的粉末涂层钢结构，体型非常小巧紧凑，是留学生公寓、宿舍或者狭小卧室空间的收纳神器。自带一层开放式下层隔板，完美拓展垂直收纳空间，放书本、充电线或者零碎杂物都非常稳固。目前电视已经完全组装完毕，免去您自己用小扳手拼装铁条的麻烦。**诚实披露**：家里养猫，属于宠物友好型环境。出货前已用酒精全面擦拭并完成静电除尘，但金属表面在日常使用中可能会有无法完全避免的微弱细小划痕，或吸附极微量猫毛浮尘。本家具不附带原厂纸箱包装或收纳袋，本地自提的买家朋友直接拎走或放进车后座即可。
